column2: Keep your seat, operator. This needs your attention more than I do.
Yes sir. May I have the verification paper?
I don't want a guess dressed up as an answer. Authenticate this.
Understood, sir. I will report what the checks establish.
The wardroom has had enough discussion about this message.
You require verification, sir?
I require a reason to end the discussion. Start with verification.
Yes sir. I'll examine the paper.
You are familiar with today's orders?
Yes sir.
Good. Apply them to this verification message.
I will, sir.
This paper has acquired a remarkable ability to move between desks. End its travels here and verify it.
Yes sir. I'll process it now.
I have been assured this message is authentic.
Shall I confirm that assessment, sir?
Confirm it or overturn it. Assurances are not your job.
Understood, sir. I'll carry out the checks.
I need this verified before I put my name to anything based on it.
Yes sir. I will give you a clear assessment.
You look occupied. Can you attend to a verification?
Certainly, sir.
Good. I would rather have it checked properly than discussed quickly.
I'll give it my full attention, sir.
The sea is full of people who would like us to believe things. Check this one.
Yes sir. I'll establish whether the message is authentic.
Take this verification paper. Keep your findings separate from your expectations.
Of course, sir. I will assess it by the regulations.
I have a question for STASEC. Is this traffic genuine?
I'll need to examine the verification message, sir.
That is why I brought it.
Yes sir. I'll begin.
No ceremony. I need this authenticated.
Right away, sir.
Somebody described this as probably reliable. I dislike the word probably.
I will verify it, sir.
Good. Give me a result I can put in a report.
Yes sir.
You don't need to know why this matters. You need to know whether it checks out.
Understood, sir. I'll keep to the verification task.
Before anyone becomes enthusiastic about this message, check its authenticity.
Yes sir. I'll process the verification paper.
I was on my way past and remembered this needed your attention.
A verification, sir?
Yes. An oversight I intend to correct before it becomes a problem.
I'll attend to it now, sir.
The last thing I need is a confident answer to the wrong question. Is this authentic?
I'll verify the message and answer that question directly, sir.
There you are. I need your professional opinion on this paper.
The authenticity assessment, sir?
Exactly. You may save the rest of your opinions for another day.
Yes sir. I'll check it now.
I would like to leave with this verified, operator.
Certainly, sir. Please let me examine the message.
I am not asking whether the news is pleasant. I am asking whether it is genuine.
Understood, sir. The verification will concern authenticity.
How sharp are your eyes today?
Quite sharp, sir.
Then put them to work. This verification paper needs checking.
At once, sir.
This has come to me with more confidence than evidence. Supply the assessment.
Yes sir. I'll verify it according to the current orders.
I assume the regulations haven't changed since I last sat down.
Today's standing orders apply, sir.
Very well. See whether this message complies with them.
Yes sir. I'll carry out the verification.
Check this before someone files it under things we already know.
Yes sir. I will establish its authenticity first.
I have no objection to unwelcome findings. I have an objection to careless ones.
Understood, sir. I'll examine the verification paper carefully.
Someone has been generous with the word official.
You would like this authenticated, sir?
I would like to know whether their generosity was justified.
I'll verify it, sir.
This is not a test of whether you agree with me. Verify the message.
Yes sir. I'll report the result of the checks.
Even if you think I won't like it.
Understood, sir. The assessment will be accurate.
Authentic, then?
Yes sir. The verification checks are satisfied.
That is not the answer I was hoping for. You are certain?
Yes sir. The message passes verification.
Very well. Hoping has never been a sound naval procedure.
No sir.
TRUE ECHO. Good. Now I can deal with the contents.
Yes sir. The authenticity is confirmed.
Before I leave, is there any qualification to your finding?
No sir. The message has been verified as authentic.
That is the sort of answer I wanted.
Glad to be of assistance, sir.
So the person who sent this was entitled to send it?
The message meets the authentication requirements, sir.
Keep to what you can establish. Good.
Yes sir.
I shall take the verified paper.
Certainly, sir. The result is TRUE ECHO.
Do you realize how much paperwork this result is going to create?
I can only confirm the authenticity, sir.
Yes, yes. I don't expect you to do the paperwork as well.
Understood, sir.
You have checked it against the orders in force?
Yes sir. It is authentic under the current requirements.
Then I have what I need.
Very good, sir.
For once, someone has brought me something genuine.
The message is verified, sir.
I see. Authentic. That makes this considerably less convenient.
Is there anything further you require, sir?
No. You have answered the question I brought you.
Yes sir.
Your finding is TRUE ECHO?
Yes sir. Authentication complete.
Good. I will handle the next part.
Understood, sir.
Excellent. I can stop asking whether this belongs on my desk.
Yes sir. The message is authentic.
The messenger seemed very pleased with himself. Apparently he had reason to be.
The verification is successful, sir.
Don't tell him I said that.
Of course, sir.
Is this a formal confirmation or a personal impression?
Formal confirmation, sir. The message passes verification.
Good. Personal impressions are plentiful enough aboard.
Yes sir.
You have saved me an argument about authenticity.
Glad to help, sir. The result is confirmed.
I don't like the news. That has no bearing on your assessment, I take it?
None, sir. The message is authentic.
Quite right. I would be concerned if it did.
Understood, sir.
All in order? Nothing that prevents acceptance?
Nothing in the verification, sir. TRUE ECHO.
Very well. I shall take it from here.
Yes sir.
An authentic message. A rare pleasure to have one question settled.
Yes sir. The verification is complete.
Do you stand by this result?
I do, sir. It meets the authentication requirements.
Good. I prefer an operator who can give a straight answer.
Thank you, sir.
I expected you to confirm it.
The checks support that conclusion, sir.
And that is why I came here rather than confirming it myself.
Yes sir.
No need for a speech. Genuine or not?
Genuine, sir. TRUE ECHO.
This means I owe somebody a rather uncomfortable conversation.
Shall I provide anything else with the assessment, sir?
No. I have the paper. The conversation is mine.
Understood, sir.
You haven't decided the contents are true merely because the message is authentic?
No sir. I have confirmed the authenticity of the communication.
Keep that distinction clear.
I will, sir.
Good. A result without a small mountain of speculation attached.
The message is authenticated, sir.
I can see why they sent it here.
Thank you, sir. The verification is complete.
Keep the standard. Don't begin expecting compliments.
No sir.
So I can put this before the other officers as verified traffic?
Yes sir. The result is TRUE ECHO.
Then the rest of the discussion is my concern.
Understood, sir.
Authentic. I shall have to take it seriously, then.
The authentication is confirmed, sir.
You are aware that I may be asked who verified it?
Yes sir. This is my assessment. The message is authentic.
Very well. That will suffice.
Thank you, sir.
I had almost convinced myself it would be false.
It passes the required checks, sir.
That is precisely why one asks a specialist. Carry on.
Yes sir.
Good work. There is enough uncertainty outside this compartment.
Thank you, sir. The message is verified.
Keep your station ready. There will be more.
I will, sir.
FALSE ECHO? You are rejecting it?
Yes sir. It does not satisfy the authentication requirements.
That is a rather expensive finding, operator.
I understand, sir. The message has failed verification.
Expense doesn't make it authentic. I know.
Yes sir.
I was assured this would pass.
I'm afraid the verification does not support that assurance, sir.
Then I shall speak to the person who gave it.
Understood, sir.
You are quite certain this is not acceptable traffic?
Yes sir. The result is FALSE ECHO.
Dammit. Now the conversation starts again.
The message is rejected, sir.
I heard you. I was considering my next conversation.
Of course, sir.
Has my bringing it here influenced your assessment?
No sir. The finding is based on the required checks.
As it should be. I will take the result.
Certainly, sir.
Rejected. Very well. Better here than after we act on it.
Yes sir. It has not been authenticated.
There must be a less troublesome answer.
Not one I can substantiate, sir. The message fails verification.
At least you understand the difference.
Yes sir.
If I ask you again, will the finding change?
Not on the evidence provided, sir.
Good. That was a question about your judgment, not an instruction to change it.
Understood, sir.
So I am leaving with a false communication.
Yes sir. The recorded assessment is FALSE ECHO.
Someone will want to know why I questioned this.
The verification result supports your concern, sir.
It would have been simpler if I had been wrong.
I understand, sir.
I don't suppose my rank makes the paper any more convincing.
The authentication requirements remain the same, sir.
Precisely. Return it to me with that finding.
Yes sir.
Tell me plainly. Has it passed?
No sir. It is rejected as a FALSE ECHO.
I can already hear somebody blaming the Obscura.
The finding concerns the message, sir.
Then I shall keep the discussion on the message.
Thank you, sir.
You are not calling the messenger a liar, are you?
No sir. I am reporting a failed authentication.
Good. I will decide what questions to put to the messenger.
Understood, sir.
Unwelcome, but clear enough. I shall take the rejected paper.
Certainly, sir. The result is FALSE ECHO.
This reached me through channels I normally trust.
It still has to meet the verification requirements, sir.
Apparently those channels need reminding of that.
Yes sir.
You seem very composed about this.
I am trying to give you an accurate report, sir.
Continue to do so. I have enough excited reports.
I will, sir.
Not authentic. There goes a perfectly good assumption.
I'm afraid so, sir. The verification has failed.
I need an answer I can defend.
The message does not satisfy the required checks, sir.
And you stand by that?
Yes sir.
Good. I shall not dress it up as anything else.
Understood, sir.
Have you mistaken my urgency for permission to overlook anything?
No sir. The message is rejected under the current requirements.
Very well. I wanted to hear that clearly.
Yes sir.
I had a suspicion this would happen. I take no pleasure in being right.
The assessment is FALSE ECHO, sir.
Can I at least tell the others it was nearly authentic?
I cannot support that description, sir. It failed verification.
No. I suppose nearly authentic is not especially useful.
No sir.
I would rather have had this finding before the wardroom meeting.
I can confirm the rejection now, sir.
Yes. You cannot verify a paper you haven't received.
That's correct, sir.
Right. This is not to be treated as verified traffic.
Correct, sir. FALSE ECHO.
Do you have a theory about who is responsible?
No supported conclusion on that, sir. Only the failed verification.
Then keep it that way until there is evidence.
Yes sir.
I shall be asked whether you understood how important this was.
I understood, sir. That is why I applied the full requirements.
A satisfactory answer. An unsatisfactory message.
Yes sir.
FALSE ECHO. Thank you for making that clear before I relied on it.
You're welcome, sir.
This is going to make somebody very uncomfortable.
The verification result is unchanged, sir.
I wasn't asking you to change it.
Understood, sir.
Rejected, then. I would like a quiet compartment while I consider this.
Certainly, sir. The assessment is complete.
Carry on with your duties. I'll deal with what follows.
Yes sir.
I have outgoing traffic for your machine. Encode it according to the orders.
Yes sir. I'll examine the request and begin processing.
Stay seated. I need this made ready for transmission.
Of course, sir. May I have the message?
The radio watch is expecting something from me.
A message for encoding, sir?
